Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands over his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack refuses to take his medication, his voice laced with defiance 🗣️.

DR. SMITH:
(firmly)
Jack, you need to take your pills. They're the only thing keeping you from harming yourself or others 💊.

JACK:
(outraged)
I don't need your pills! I'm fine! 🙄

DR. SMITH:
(exasperated)
Fine? You're not fine, Jack. You're a danger to yourself and those around you 🚨.

JACK:
(suddenly calm)
I'll take them, but you have to prove they're safe. You have to take them yourself 🤔.

DR. SMITH:
(skeptical)
What are you talking about, Jack? 🤷‍♂️

JACK:
(serious)
I want you to take the pills. Show me they're safe 💊.

Dr. Smith hesitates for a moment, then reluctantly agrees to take the pills himself 💊. He opens the bottle and pours two pills into his hand 💪.

DR. SMITH:
(to himself)
Fine. I'll take them. But if I start to feel any effects, I'm blaming you 🤣.

Dr. Smith swallows the pills and waits, expecting to feel some sort of reaction 🤔. But nothing happens. He looks around the room, confused, and that's when he sees Jack standing in front of him, a mischievous grin spreading across his face 😏.

JACK:
(laughing)
You're not taking the pills, Doc. You're the one who's been taking them all along 🤣.

Dr. Smith's eyes widen in shock as he realizes the truth: he's been the one with the schizophrenia all along 🤯. Jack is just a figment of his imagination, a manifestation of his own paranoid delusions 🌪️.

DR. SMITH:
(stunned)
No... it can't be... 🤯

JACK:
(winking)
You're the one who's been living in a world of your own making, Doc. And I'm the one who's been setting the rules 🎩.

The camera zooms out as Dr. Smith's world begins to unravel, the pills on his desk now a symbol of his own fragile mental state 💔.

FADE TO BLACK 🌑
